subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Voltage, Capacity, and Power
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Voltage, Capacity, and Power.

hook.text: Three numbers define a battery's ability—voltage, capacity in kilowatt-hours, and power in kilowatts.

buildup.text: Voltage is the push that drives electrons. Capacity is how much energy the battery holds in total.

discovery.text: Power determines how fast energy can flow out—high power means quick acceleration.

twist.text: A battery can have massive capacity but low power—like a huge water tank with a tiny faucet.

climax.text: EV designers balance all three to match range, acceleration, and charging speed for each model.

punchline.text: Good EV batteries need the right balance, not just big numbers.

quiz.question: What does battery capacity measured in kilowatt-hours represent?

details.summary: Voltage, capacity, and power are the three fundamental metrics of any battery. Voltage drives electron flow, capacity measures total stored energy, and power determines how quickly energy can be delivered.
details.whyItMatters: Understanding these three metrics is essential for comparing batteries. Higher voltage enables more efficient power delivery, greater capacity means more range, and more power means faster acceleration.
takeaways: Voltage is the electrical pressure that pushes current through circuits
Capacity in kilowatt-hours tells you how far the car can drive
Power in kilowatts determines acceleration and top speed capability

faq.question: Why are some EVs moving to 800-volt battery architectures?
faq.answer: Higher voltage allows the same power to be delivered at lower current, reducing cable thickness, weight, heat loss, and charging time. Porsche and Hyundai pioneered 800-volt systems for faster performance.

faq.question: What is the difference between kW and kWh in EV specifications?
faq.answer: Kilowatts measure power, the rate of energy delivery. Kilowatt-hours measure total energy capacity, how much is stored. A 75 kWh battery delivering 150 kW would theoretically last 30 minutes at peak output.
